entities.summary: Marta Portal Nicolás was a Spanish writer, critic, journalist, and professor associated with the Generation of '50. She was a recipient of the Premio Planeta de Novela. Marta Portal was a journalists & chroniclers from Nava (1930-08-10, Nava–2016-08-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
